verdict.rationale: UCP's own site says the complete technical specification, documentation and reference implementations are in a public GitHub repository. An independent probe confirmed ucp.dev serves a versioned spec index with dated releases and a GitHub org, and keyless runtime probes showed the protocol can be implemented and exercised without credentials or agreements. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of the spec's license terms confirming implementation requires no signed agreement.

support.subject: As a developer, the commerce protocol this product speaks is published as an open, versioned specification I can read and implement without signing anything

citations.quote: The complete technical specification, documentation, and reference implementations are hosted in our public GitHub repository.
the Universal Commerce Protocol spec is published in the open — https://ucp.dev/llms.txt serves the versioned specification index
a REAL cart was created keylessly on Shopify's own hardware store through the UCP protocol
a platform profile is a JSON document that describes the protocol version and capabilities the platform supports
